title: Strawberry Newspaper (Ichigo Shimbun)
lede: Sanrio’s own magazine, published since April 1975: character news, manga, recipes, and cut-out crafts for readers called “Strawberry Mates”.
summary: Sanrio’s full-color tabloid magazine of character news and crafts, published since 1975.

evidence.note: Relies on the Wikipedia article. No issue was inspected; covers seen only as small shop thumbnails were not used.

styles.note: The house magazine that has spread Sanrio’s character culture to readers since 1975; its look is not yet verified here.

context: Wikipedia says the first issue was published in April 1975 with Snoopy on the cover and cost 100 yen. It appeared twice a month and became monthly in 1982. By 2019, 600 issues had been published, each printed in 100,000 copies according to Sanrio. [Wikipedia: Strawberry Newspaper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strawberry_Newspaper).

The magazine carries news about Sanrio characters and products, drawing lessons, origami, manga serials, character recipes, paper crafts, and cut-out games. It uses a large tabloid format printed in full color, with a poster and a bonus item in each issue. Readers have helped name new characters, starting with the Little Twin Stars in 1975. [Wikipedia: Strawberry Newspaper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strawberry_Newspaper).
interpretation: The magazine is the editorial side of the style: it made Sanrio’s characters a serial world that readers took part in, not just decorations on goods.
